_note: Manual kickoff-time overrides. fixturedownload.com is the ONLY fixture source and its DateUtc is wrong for some fixtures: on 2026-08-15 every La Liga matchday-1 kickoff was exactly 10 hours early, because the feed published the LOCAL time on a 12-hour clock with the PM dropped and then labelled it 'Z' (19:30 CEST -> '07:30Z'; true UTC 17:30). A wrong kickoff freezes the pick hours early -- before any confirmed XI exists -- and hides the fixture from every board once the fake time passes. Keys are 'Home|Away' in CANONICAL club names, unique within a season. Values are the true kickoff in UTC. VERIFIED ONLY: two independent sources or an official club announcement, same bar as transfers.json. Never extrapolate the +10h pattern onto an unverified fixture -- the plausibility guard in fixtures.py already stops an unverified bad time from locking a pick, so a missing entry is safe and a guessed one is not.

Celta|Osasuna._postponed: NOT a time correction -- the match was POSTPONED. A fungal disease in the Balaidos pitch forced LaLiga, both clubs and the RFEF to move it from Sunday 16 August to Thursday 27 August. The feed still lists the original Sunday slot, so without this the model would have treated a match that was never played as finished and waited forever for a result.
